'''Plastone''' was a building material. An abandoned [[Factory/Legends|factory]] that [[Celia Durasha]] hid out in on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] was constructed of [[Steel/Legends|steel]] and plastone.<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
